Best value under ₹50,000 is the Acer Aspire 14 AI at about ₹43,999 with the Lenovo ThinkBook 16 the strongest on speed.

Laptop	Price (about)	Processor	RAM / storage	Screen
Acer Aspire 14 AI	₹43,999	Snapdragon X (X1-26-100)	16GB / 512GB	14-inch WUXGA, 120Hz
Lenovo ThinkBook 16	₹46,990	Ryzen 5 7535HS	16GB / 512GB	16-inch WUXGA, 60Hz
Acer Aspire 3 (A324-53)	₹40,990 to ₹49,990	Core i5-1334U	16GB / 512GB	14-inch FHD, 60Hz
Aspire 14 AI: best battery life and the smoothest screen.
ThinkBook 16: fastest chip of the three and about 9 hours of battery in one review, but it is big and better kept on a desk.
Aspire 3: cheapest, good for students.

These figures come from one roundup (TechVerdict, last updated Fri 23 Oct 2026), which did not test the laptops itself. Prices differ a lot between sellers, so check the exact AI and live price before buying.
